tool_input.command:
cd /workspace/task && cat > write.py << 'EOF'
import openpyxl
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('output.xlsx')
ws = wb['Result']

# G-I (Shrawan) use column I from Master-RM; J-L (Bhadra) use column K
ws['G10'] = "=INDEX('Master-RM'!$I$8:$I$20,MATCH($G$2,'Master-RM'!$A$8:$A$20,0))"
ws['H10'] = "=INDEX('Master-RM'!$I$8:$I$20,MATCH($H$2,'Master-RM'!$A$8:$A$20,0))"
ws['I10'] = "=INDEX('Master-RM'!$I$8:$I$20,MATCH($I$2,'Master-RM'!$A$8:$A$20,0))"
ws['J10'] = "=INDEX('Master-RM'!$K$8:$K$20,MATCH($J$2,'Master-RM'!$A$8:$A$20,0))"
ws['K10'] = "=INDEX('Master-RM'!$K$8:$K$20,MATCH($K$2,'Master-RM'!$A$8:$A$20,0))"
ws['L10'] = "=INDEX('Master-RM'!$K$8:$K$20,MATCH($L$2,'Master-RM'!$A$8:$A$20,0))"

wb.save('output.xlsx')
print("saved")
EOF
python3 write.py
